classes.legitimate-data-label: Content, a label, or recorded provenance. Belongs in the game and cannot become one world's fixed gameplay instance.
classes.dev-or-test-only-fixture: A fixture literal that a test, a developer route or explicit scenario data may hold, and that ordinary New Game and Continue cannot reach.
classes.production-hardcode: A world-instance gameplay identity an ordinary player can be handed because a production module spells it out. None may remain.

cases.rationale: The authored measure bank. Each entry's designation is content the bank has always carried, and it is now exposed to production only as `LegislativeBlueprint.authoredDesignation`, which no production path reads: the standalone developer scenario files its own bill with it, and the content index titles the entry with it. What a player's world files is numbered by `nextMeasureDesignation` from that world's own jurisdiction numbering. Guarded by src/presentation/dehardwire-measure-identity.test.ts ('the authored bank').

Recorded provenance on judicial kernel definitions — the instruments a kernel was compiled from, matched here only because a rule citation looks like a bill designation. Not a measure and not a world instance. Whether any of it should render on a player surface is ROLE C's separation question, not a dehardwire case; the citation itself stays internal.
